reading.rtitle: Four stars -- a bad start, but a great stay
reading.source: Guest review, posted by Leão S.
paras: I arrived at the Riverside Hotel at eleven at night, and I was very tired after a long flight.
I had a booking for three nights, but my name was not in the system. The receptionist checked two times, but there was nothing.
The hotel was full that night, so I asked to talk to the manager. She came in five minutes, and she was very kind.
It was their mistake, so she gave me an upgrade to a suite on the tenth floor, and a discount for the first night.
The suite was big and very quiet, and the view of the river was beautiful. Breakfast was good, but the coffee was weak.
Why only four stars? Because the start was bad. But the manager solved the problem in ten minutes, so I want to stay here again.

listenings.text: So, I arrived in Chicago on Friday, and I went to my hotel. I had a booking, but it was for the wrong dates. It was for next Friday! The hotel was full, so I needed to find another hotel at ten at night. I called three hotels, but they were full too. Then the receptionist called a friend at a small hotel near the station, and they had a room. It was small and a little old, but it was clean and very cheap. And you know what? The breakfast was the best of my trip. So now I always check my dates two times.

My first day in Mexico City was a little crazy. The flight was on time, but my bag was the last one on the belt. I wanted to take the train to the hotel, but it was very crowded, so I took a taxi. The taxi was slow, because the traffic was terrible, so I arrived late for dinner. The restaurant was full, but the waiter was very kind, and he found a small table for me near the kitchen. I ate tacos and I talked to the cook. I was very tired, but I was happy. A long day, but a good end.
